I’ll find the payload conversion code, fix dictionary handling, and run focused tests for named inputs and serialization errors. I’ll use the repository’s Python style skill for the code and test changes.
The dictionary branch is unpacking input names instead of name/value pairs. The regression tests already staged in the workspace cover the requested cases; all four reproduce the bug. I’ll preserve those tests and change the loop to use `data.items()`.
Fixed `dump_input_data` to iterate over `data.items()`, preserving each input name alongside its serialized array.

The existing staged regression tests cover 1D/multidimensional arrays, custom input keys with parameters, and clear errors for unsupported values.

All 34 tests in `tests/utils/test_proto_json_utils.py` passed, though pytest’s summary hook subsequently hit a sandbox `PermissionError`. No dependencies were installed.
